install_go_toolset: download and install a pinned Go toolset to a specified directory
bootstrap_go_environment: bootstrap a hermetic Go installation and return environment variables for use
get_go_environ: get a copy of os.environ with GOROOT, GOPATH, and GOBIN set for Go builds
find_go_executable: find the full path to a Go executable in GOROOT or workspace bin directories
remove_directory: recursively remove a directory with Windows read-only file handling
